content: Leading Quran apps (Quran.com, Muslim Pro, iQuran, Al Quran Tafsir&ByWord) converge on: multiple Arabic mushaf typography styles, gapless multi-reciter audio with repeat/loop, word-by-word translation, 60+ language translations and multiple tafsir works, bookmarking/tagging/last-read-position sync, in-app search, night mode, and offline access. Quran.com is noted as ad-free with the cleanest interface; Muslim Pro bundles Quran reading with prayer times/qibla but is criticized for heavy ad load.
